column2: Hey! Kikkai!
Grandpa!
Even if society thinks it's normal to pick on the weak on the sly, in this house that won't fly!
Hmph! Talk back to me and this is what you get!
Hyaaa!
Hee hee hee...! The automatic room-cleaning device!
Treating your elders like garbage! Hey! Let me back in the house!!
If you're so mad, come get me!
Whaaat!
Well, well, how embarrassing that you saw all that.
I'm Fuyukai Maka.\n\nThat was my grandson, Kikkai Maka!
I'm {p}.
Anyhow, things look odd outside, eh? It's awful noisy, and the scenery seems to have changed...
In Science City right now...
Science City!?\n\nHmph! I can't stand science or machines!
He fell for the land mine I set for Pochi!
No idea why, but there's machines and weapons all over the place! My research is going swimmingly!
He's picking up broken machines from Science City...
Alphonne!
He won't even answer unless I use his full name... Alphonne Louis Steinbeck the Third!
Whaaat, Pochi?
Aaah, you called me plain Pochi again! Punishment! Punishment!
But your name IS Pochi.
I keep telling you to put "Doctor" in front! You're just my servant, and you've got a fancier name than me!
'Cause I'm the bigger shot.
Punishment! Punishment!
What weird people...
Gather up any parts we can use!\n\nThen we'll build a mighty weapon and blast the Maka family sky-high!
Blast 'em sky-high!
Better not get involved with them...
Gather up any parts we can use!
Blast the Maka family sky-high!
Forward, that way! Rat-a-tat-taaat!
You dummy, don't you know what "forward" means!? Punishment! Punishment!
There they go again...
Alphonne! Haul it, quick!
You dummy! Don't haul ME! Punishment! Punishment! Alphonne, haul THAT!
Alphonne Louis Steinbeck the Third! Haul THAT!
Kikkai, this is terrible!
What is it, Grandpa... Hyah!
FIIIRE!
A failure...\n\nThis weapon's too powerful for a human to use...
Yaaay!
Are those two going to be okay...?
They're fine, they're fine! Happens all the time! ...Huh? Grandpa, what's wrong?
Look around ya. The scenery's changed...
Whoa, you're right!?
Big trouble! What the heck happened!? Come to think of it, who are you guys?
M-me? Well, um, actually...
Whaaat, all kinds of worlds from different dimensions got connected!?
Things are happening that common sense says can't happen.
Common sense is the sort of thing that gets turned on its head, sonny.
Grandpa, that's a good one! All right, I've decided! I'm joining {p}'s party! 'Cause it sounds like fun, hee hee...!
I'm comin' too!
Leaving this lying around in a place like this... how dangerous.
I'm starving...\n\nAlphonne, can't you come up with an idea to get food?
Mmmmm...
Got one?
Feels like it's comin'! Oh, it's comin', it's comin'!
Yaaay, great!
Finally, it came out!
Punishment! Punishment!
Ooh! Food!!\n\nI'll be your servant!
I'll follow you for life!
I'm starving...
Starviiing...
Is this... a robot...? Or a cyborg? It's like a walking pile of weapons...
I am Iron Kaiser! The ultimate cyborg warrior! It seems the operation is complete...
Hmm! You! The Shutendoji!
You know me?
I had a father...\n\nA strong man who had never lost to anyone. But one man's sword... cut my father's body in two!
The place was the Fang Meadow at the Dark Temple! My father's name was Kukai Jawanbo of the Somashu!!
Jawanbo's son!?
Whoaaa!

To defeat you, I took machines into my body! I underwent operation after operation to grow stronger, and now I am the ultimate cyborg! Shutendoji! I carry on the will of my father Jawanbo, and I will defeat you!
Hey! Hold on a second!
Oh? You're the boy who was with Jiro Shutendo, aren't you?
This is no time for me to be fighting you.
That's right. Listen, Iron Kaiser.\n\nRight now, the world is in serious trouble...
You modified your body?
To defeat the Shutendoji, who killed my father, Kukai Jawanbo!
Y-yeah...
I like the courage you showed revealing who you are! Are you also of a clan that protects the Shutendoji?
The worlds have been linked and strange things are happening!? I see... Now it all makes sense!
There's no way my strong father could lose to the likes of the Shutendoji! Father lost because the worlds were linked! In a proper world, Kukai Jawanbo would never lose to the Shutendoji!
Kukai Jawanbo could never lose to the Shutendoji. It was a mistake caused by the Dimension Chain!
Boy, you're giving this to me!\n\nWith this, I'll power up even more! Hahaha!
...But what's the point of getting stronger? My goal of defeating Doji has all but lost its meaning...
Iron Kaiser! Come with me! And let's solve the mystery of the Dimension Chain!
Oh, a splendid idea!\n\nIf we solve the mystery of the Dimension Chain, the world will go back to how it was! Then my father Jawanbo will come back to life, and we'll defeat Doji!
If that happens... it'd be a problem, though...
